# Rene Turcios

> Rene Turcios is an AI entrepreneur and founder of Agentcies.co,
> known as the original vibe coder and San Francisco's "hackathon
> king": 200+ hackathon wins building AI/ML and XR projects with
> no traditional code — ideas translated through AI. His work has
> been featured in the SF Standard, Slashdot, and LunarTech. This
> site is his portfolio: live projects, press, case studies, and
> speaking.

## About and contact

- [Home](https://reneturcios.replit.app/): Portfolio overview — live projects, about, press, demos, and contact sections on one page.
- [Book a call](https://cal.com/reneturcios/15min): Schedule 15 minutes with Rene.
- [GitHub — CloudCorpRecords](https://github.com/CloudCorpRecords): Open-source tools and projects, including the Greenlight / wallcheck family of agent-transparency tools.

## Projects

- [Live projects](https://reneturcios.replit.app/#live-projects): 11 published apps, including Clipwise (AI video clipping), Rene Builds It, Taskcato Chat, Walk The Line, Runehalla Duel, and LensDeal — each links out to the live app.
- [Case study: Agentcies](https://reneturcios.replit.app/case-studies/agentcies.html)
- [Case study: DataCoach](https://reneturcios.replit.app/case-studies/datacoach.html)
- [Case study: OpenGov](https://reneturcios.replit.app/case-studies/opengov.html)
